title: 零基础舞蹈学习《来跳舞》 直播详细教学

method.teacher_system: The teacher breaks down the dance into small, manageable chunks, focusing on the feet first before adding the arms. He uses a mirror view to allow learners to easily copy his movements and provides clear, repetitive practice for each section. He concludes by combining the learned segments into a continuous flow.
method.signature: The teacher explicitly instructs learners to look forward rather than at their hands during specific arm movements to maintain proper posture and focus.

practices.what: The teacher breaks the dance into two-bar segments, teaching the footwork first.
The teacher adds arm movements to the previously learned footwork.
The teacher repeats the arm movement sequence four times to ensure mastery.
The teacher leads a follow-along round of the first eight-count sequence.
The teacher introduces the second eight-count sequence, focusing on a new footwork pattern.
The teacher adds specific arm styling to the second sequence.
The teacher combines the first and second sequences for a full practice run.
The teacher introduces the final segment involving a wrist-turning arm movement.
The teacher leads a final, continuous practice of all learned segments.

beliefs.belief: Dancing is a way to express oneself and enjoy a popular song.

feelings.response: The teacher laughs at their own mistake, making the learner feel comfortable and at ease.

moments.says: The teacher welcomes the learner and invites them to learn the dance together.
The teacher advises the learner to focus on the footwork first and keep their hands still.
The teacher makes light of their own hiccup after drinking water, normalizing the situation.
The teacher encourages the learner by stating that many students have already learned this step.
The teacher asks the learner to pay attention to the changes in their body and the coordination of their head and hands.
The teacher invites the learner to slowly feel the slow-motion movement.

mentor.what_stays: The teacher leaves the learner feeling capable and encouraged to master the dance through patience and practice.

struggles.theme: Difficulty keeping up with the pace

method.limits: The video does not include music during the breakdown, which may make it harder for learners to practice the rhythm until the final run-through.
